acceptanceCriteria: Each refusal class (inexact sidecar, failing OCM, retired 0.x map) records the verifier stage reached and either a partial result or a NOT_RUN reason
body: Found by the V1-0632 gap 1 lane (PR #1287, CEM-V1-293). corvint-dashboard-snapshot cem-stable refuses these inputs but cannot retain a verifier result, because the verifier is not reached or not run. Expected: each refusal names which verification step was reached and keeps the partial verifier result or an explicit NOT_RUN reason. Actual: the refusal carries only the code and the input digests.

title: dashboard cem-stable refusal keeps no verifier result when the sidecar is inexact, the OCM fails or the map is a retired 0.x map
